constraints.constraint: Prevention by Design: Run button disabled until state.is_valid() returns True
State Class: Use AnalysisState.summary() for display, is_valid() for validation
UI Framework: Use ipywidgets for all widgets
Widget callbacks use observe() pattern with names='value' for checkboxes
Run button click shows placeholder - actual query execution is Epic 3
All selection callbacks must trigger _update_summary_panel() and _update_run_button_state()
